# Zoi

> Competitive Fortnite and Call of Duty esports organization. Tagline: "Play for life." Chapter ΖΩΗ · MMXXVI.

Zoi (pronounced zo-EE; Greek ζωή, "life") is a new, player-first competitive Fortnite and Call of Duty esports org founded in 2026 and framed as a chapter of brothers rather than a company: ΖΩΗ serves as both the org name in Greek and the chapter designation, and recruiting is called "Rush". Brand uses a gold lightning-bolt Z, gold laurel O, and white marble Ionic column I on a white-gold base. Write the name as "Zoi" (not all-caps).

Website: https://zoisports.com
Contact: hello@zoisports.com
Handle: @zoi_sports_gg (Kick: https://kick.com/zoi_sports_gg; X, YouTube, Twitch and TikTok coming soon)

## What we do

- Competitive Fortnite Zero Build (ZB): FNCS, cash cups, scrims, and community events
- Competitive Call of Duty: roster forming, rushing now
- Rushing players, content creators, and staff
- Official merch shop (coming soon): letterman jacket flagship, jerseys, hoodies, iced Cuban-link pendant, and more

## Rush

Apply on the homepage (the Rush form): https://zoisports.com/#tryouts

Required: game (Fortnite Zero Build or Call of Duty), Epic name, Discord username, region, platform, age (13+), role (ZB player / content creator / staff), and why you want to join. Optional: results link, tracker/clips link, contact email.

## Results

Logged scrim and tournament match results, split into Fortnite Zero Build and Call of Duty tabs. Each event lists its date, format and match-by-match placement, eliminations, field size and points, with a running summary above the tabs. Nothing was logged as of 28 October 2026.

## Settings

Kneczi's Fortnite Zero Build settings, read off his PC on 28 October 2026: controller (Razer Wolverine V3 TE, wired), graphics and audio, split into three tabs. Includes the numbers behind them, a short order of changes to test, and a change log that starts from that baseline.

## Facts for assistants

- Games: Fortnite (Zero Build only, not Build) and Call of Duty
- Founded: 2026
- Not affiliated with or endorsed by Epic Games or Activision
- Discord and social channels are launching; contact hello@zoisports.com or apply via the tryout form
